patch_description: The previous edit failed because its SEARCH block did not match the file verbatim. This retry uses only minimal, highly-likely anchor lines (`import numpy as np` and the final `return points`) to make the edit robust. The changes implement the recommended improvements: (1) precompute the sorted triangle-index triplet array once at module level so it is shared across all seeds and iterations, (2) clamp perturbed candidate points to the unit box so moves that would leave the domain are repaired instead of wasted/rejected, and (3) exit-early pruning — if a seed's best score after a modest number of iterations is far below the incumbent (less than 50%), abandon it and reallocate budget to more promising seeds, concentrating the iteration budget where it pays off. All changes are deterministic (no new randomness introduced).
